headline: A safer production floor, every shift.
heroLede: Jayco builds more than 200 caravans and motorhomes a week, with forklifts, gantries, saws and people sharing the floor all day. This page shows how cameras on site could flag near misses, people in exclusion zones and missing PPE as they happen, across your production sites.
forkLede: Cameras over aisles, crossings and loading areas track forklifts and people together. When a forklift and a person come too close, or a forklift speeds through a pedestrian area, the supervisor gets an alert straight away.
zoneLede: Zones are drawn around gantry lifts, chassis welding, saws and CNC routers. If someone steps inside while a load or machine is moving, the system raises an alert and logs a clip.
ppeLede: In the timber and panel shop, near the saws and routers, the cameras check for safety glasses, hearing protection and hi-vis, and flag a miss to the area leader.
machLede: Sensors on the saws, CNC routers, compressors and gantry hoists learn how each machine normally runs. A rise in vibration, heat or current is flagged days before a breakdown, so maintenance can plan the fix.
machAlert: CNC router 2: spindle vibration rising for 6 days. Suggested check within the week.

later: A camera at the end of the line checks windows, seals, badges and panel fit on every van before dispatch. This needs a model trained on your vans, so we scope it with your quality team.
